title: Register for and pay payroll tax
what: Register with the state revenue office and pay payroll tax once wages paid in Australia pass the state's threshold.

sources.title: Payroll Tax Act 2009 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: An employer who is not already registered must apply for registration as an employer under this Act if— (a) during a month the employer pays or is liable to pay, anywhere, wages of more than the prescribed amount per week that are wholly or partly taxable wages;

triggers.unit: AUD of taxable wages a financial year (annual threshold)
triggers.note: Registration is triggered month by month, when wages pass the monthly or weekly equivalent; groups share one threshold.

sources.title: Payroll Tax Act 2009 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.locator: Sch 1, cl 1, definition of TA (version of 1 Jul 2024)
sources.quote: relevant financial year means the financial year to which the calculation of the relevant payroll tax relates TA or threshold amount is $1 500 000.

reach.note: Every employer, by taxable wages; the Act's exemptions are not yet recorded.

confidence_note: Quoted from the Open Australian Legal Corpus copy of the version shown (DECISIONS E-118); later changes not checked. SA's official update packages can confirm it (phase D).

assessment.summary: A tax on wages above a tax-free threshold. The threshold makes it a tax on growing past a certain size, and exemptions narrow the base; a broad, flat payroll tax would distort less. Firms bunch just below South Australia's threshold.

marks.reason: The threshold is a tax on growing past it, which can hold firms below it.
Thresholds and exemptions make the tax fall unevenly across employers, distorting hiring and firm size.

assessment.confidence_note: Marks from the register's assessment of the same law (sa-payroll-tax). Evidence on bunching is mixed: e61 found strong bunching at South Australia's threshold; Treasury found little at most states' thresholds before 2015.
